known_pitfall_claim: The induction axiom applies to A = P \setminus \{t_2\} from the stated successor-closure property alone and therefore yields A = P.
pitfall_counterexample: Let P = ℕ with base 0 and successor S(n)=n+1. Take t₂=0 and A=P\{t₂}={n∈ℕ | n≠0}. For every n∈A, n≥1, so S(n)≥2 and S(n)∈A. Thus A is successor-closed. But 0∈P and 0∉A, hence A≠P.
